profileText: a Representative from Michigan; born in Rochester Hills, Oakland County, Mich., June 24, 1983; graduated from Seaholm Maple High School, Birmingham, Mich., 2001; B.A., American University, Washington, D.C., 2005; M.A., American University, Washington, D.C., 2007; presidential campaign aide, United States Senator Hillary Clinton of New York, 2007-2008; presidential campaign aide, United States Senator Barack Obama of Illinois, 2008; chief of staff, U.S. Auto Rescue Task Force, 2009-2011; business executive; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Sixteenth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2019-present).
